pokedexEntries.sc: This Pokémon apparently ties the base of its neck into a knot so that energy stored in its belly does not escape from its beak.

pokedexEntries.vi: Thanks to a behavior of theirs known as “synchronizing,” an entire flock of these Pokémon can attack simultaneously in perfect harmony.

pokedexEntries.za: A flock of Flamigo can reach numbers of over 10,000. The sight of one of these massive flocks moving together in sync is incredible to behold.
